summary_en: Special anniversary dividend 5.5 yen/share (TSE listing 10th anniversary, record date 30 Sep 2026). Ordinary dividend maintained at 29.5 yen/share, total 35.0 yen/share for FY9/26. Dividend policy targets 50% payout ratio and 18% DOE.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Tokyo Stock Exchange Listing 10th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: Insource resolved on 21 July 2026 to implement a special commemorative dividend marking its 10th anniversary of listing on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company will pay a special dividend of 5.5 yen per share with a record date of 30 September 2026, in addition to the ordinary dividend of 29.5 yen per share, bringing total dividends to 35.0 yen per share for the fiscal year ending 30 September 2026. The company stated that the special dividend is intended to express gratitude to shareholders for their long-term support. The ordinary dividend remains unchanged from prior guidance and is part of the company's stated dividend policy targeting a payout ratio of 50% and return on equity of 18%.
